name: Sutugius

attributes.attribute: a Continental Celtic god with pre-Celtic roots
the Roman war god linked to him

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Sutugius was a Continental Celtic god. A few inscriptions from France prove his name. Scholars think his roots reach back before the Celts came to the region. The Romans set him beside their own god of war, Mars. The god left no long story, only the weight of his name carried in stone and brief text. Scholars place him before the Celtic age, a remnant of an older people. The Romans who met him gave him the face of Mars, so one more native god was drawn into the Roman order.
